GT2 pulley (2 mm pitch)

A timing pulley for GT2 belts with 2 mm pitch: set the teeth, the belt width and the bore, with or without flanges and a hub. Pitch diameter = teeth x 2 mm / pi; the outside diameter is 0.508 mm less. Belt fit widens the grooves for 3D printing. Export it with File > Export... (STL or 3MF to print, STEP for CAD). Tooth outline from droftarts' Parametric Pulley (thingiverse.com/thing:16627), CC BY-SA 4.0; this Jig is shared under the same licence.

Parameters: Teeth, Belt width, Belt fit, Bore, Hub, Hub diameter, Hub length, Flanges

Laser-cut box

A finger-jointed box with a loose lid, for laser cutting from sheet. Set the outside size, the sheet thickness, the finger width and your laser's kerf. To cut it: File > Export..., choose DXF or SVG and the face set "Cut sheet" (file.export {"path": "box.svg", "set": "Cut sheet"}): all six panels on one sheet at true size, kerf included.

Parameters: Width, Depth, Height, Sheet thickness, Finger width, Kerf, Clearance, Thumb notch radius, Lid hole radius

Welding table

A fixture welding table to cut from 1/4 in steel plate: a top plate with a 2 in grid of 16 mm holes on a grid of half-lapped ribs, joined by tabs in slots shaped for plug welds. Set the plate size (capped at 48 x 36 in so it stays quick, also in the browser), your cutter's kerf and the slot clearance. To cut it: File > Export..., choose DXF or SVG and the face set "Cut sheet" (file.export {"path": "table.dxf", "set": "Cut sheet"}): the plate and every rib on one sheet at true size, kerf included.

Parameters: Length, Width, Kerf, Clearance, Tabs per cell
